scope: Read-only comparison of30 lesson examples,3 CSS labs and20 glossary entries; runtime not audited in this subtask.
limitations: Static source comparison documents relationships, not legal authorship, title, originality, or exclusive rights.
User supplied original tree may itself include third-party or prior AI contributions; no contracts or original creation records inspected.

The game questions, explanations, chapter/glossary arrangement, quiz and practice UI are newly created content about the website; matching a short generic idiom does not establish historical origination.
Paths shown in lessons generally target the refactored/visual copy; they are not all present in original supplied layout.

summary.conclusion: Curriculum is grounded in specific original website values,labels,handlers and CSS plus refactor/visual-pass changes. It is not a direct execution or wholesale repackaging of the original website code.
